NANCY J. DeLISI
VICE PRESIDENT & TREASURER, INTERNATIONAL
PHILIP MORRIS MANAGEMENT CORP.

Nancy J. DeLisi was appointed vice president & treasurer, international for Philip Morris Management Corp. in August 1991.

Ms. DeLisi joined Philip Morris in December 1985 as director of corporate finance. She served as assistant treasurer of the corporation from December 1989 to August 1991.
Prior to joining the company, Ms. DeLisi was treasurer of Teleco Oilfield Services Inc. from 1981 to 1985. Earlier, she was assistant vice president of Citibank from 1977 to 1981.
Ms. DeLisi attended the University of Texas and received a bachelor's degree in 1972 and an M.B.A. in 1974. She also studied for a year at St. Mary's University in San Antonio, Texas.
Philip Morris Companies Inc. has five principal operating companies: Philip Morris U.S.A., Philip Morris International Inc., Kraft Foods, Inc., Miller Brewing Company and Philip Morris Capital Corporation.
